description: This file defines the StorageService class responsible for managing persistent storage of journal entries using SharedPreferences. It includes methods to load and save entries, as well as generating demo entries when initializing.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for loading and saving journal entries to persistent storage with demo data seeding.

methods.name: loadEntries
methods.description: Loads journal entries from storage, seeding demo data if none exists on first run.

methods.name: saveEntries
methods.description: Saves a list of journal entries to persistent storage.

methods.name: _demoEntries
methods.description: Generates a list of sample journal entries for demo purposes.
